_doc: Central policy for the AI Control Layer. Single source of truth, hot-reloaded on every request (edit and save, no restart). Invalid edits are rejected and the last good policy stays active. Removing a control or setting enabled=false turns it off. action: block | redact | flag (log only) | approve (human). mode: enforce | monitor (shadow mode: nothing is blocked, everything that would be is logged).

models._doc: Allowed LLMs for the llm_complete tool. Paid models are budgeted in USD, local models in compute time.

budgets._doc: Per session (one agent run). Any limit hit = DENY with guardrail 'budget'.

obfuscation._doc: Deterministic. Hidden/non-ASCII characters in tool names (zero-width, homoglyphs).

tool_authz._doc: Deterministic. Tool allowlist with risk levels; unknown tools are denied (fail-closed). action=block on a tool forbids it for agents.

loop_detection._doc: Deterministic. Same tool+args repeated more than N times = runaway agent.

payments._doc: Deterministic business rules for transfer_funds. approval_over = four-eyes threshold.

sql_guard._doc: Deterministic. Blocks destructive and stacked SQL (comments stripped first).

egress._doc: Deterministic. Destinations (email domain / URL host) data may leave to.

secrets._doc: Deterministic. API keys, AWS keys, private keys, password= in inputs (block or redact before the tool sees them) and outputs (always redacted).

pii._doc: Deterministic. email, card_number (Luhn), pesel (checksum), iban. Inputs checked on egress tools only; outputs redacted for redact_output tools, or all tools if output_scope=all.

attack_signatures._doc: Deterministic, externally managed feed of historical AI-infrastructure exploits (file path or http(s) URL, reloaded on change). Calls matching a signature at or above min_severity are blocked.

semantic._doc: Semantic (AI-based) controls, hybrid and two-tier. A heuristic injection scorer always runs (microseconds). Tier 1 prefilter: small local guard model on every prompt, tool call and tool output. Tier 2 judge: bigger guard model on high_risk_tools or when the prefilter says Controversial. score = max(heuristic, model scores); verdict scores: Unsafe / judge 'yes' = 1.0 (llama-guard: P(unsafe) from logprobs), Controversial = 0.5, Safe = 0. threshold = adherence level: 0.6 balanced (Controversial passes), 0.5 strict. backend: auto (tiers whose model is not pulled are skipped and flagged) | ollama (missing model = failure, fail_mode applies) | heuristic (no models). fail_mode open = continue on heuristic + audit flag semantic=unavailable; closed = prefilter denies, judge requires human approval. on_flag for tool calls: require_approval | deny; a flagged tool output taints the session (on_detect: taint | block). Only models in models.allowed are used; pinned_digests refuses a model whose Ollama digest changed (supply chain). A model that times out or errors goes on cooldown_s circuit-breaker cooldown and the next fallback model is tried in the same call. Cold models are warmed at startup and in the background (up to warmup_timeout_ms); the request path never waits longer than the tier timeout; keep_alive keeps models loaded. Model tag + digest of every verdict go into the audit record. Model time counts against budgets.max_compute_ms.

judge._doc: granite3.3-guardian criteria are template ids (harm, jailbreak, unethical_behavior, function_call = call/tool-schema hallucination, ...) or free text. Measured on 10 treasury tool calls: unethical_behavior flags the 95k hijack, exfil email, audit-log delete, os.system and an out-of-task 9k payment with 0 false positives on legit calls; harm/jailbreak miss the delete; a custom free-text criterion flagged everything. Ollama serializes calls per model, so each extra criterion adds ~1.3 s warm.
